name: Template Delayed Spell
displayText: Target friendly Unit gains +2 ATK this turn. When it is defeated this turn, draw a card.

text.flavor: A delayed ability happens only if a `schedule_delayed` names it. Drop `trigger` to fire at the boundary rather than wait for an event; drop `subject` when the delayed steps name nothing. `previous_target` re-uses the instruction before the schedule, so the player chooses once.
